tool.name: process_docx_tool
tool.description: Use for Microsoft Word .docx input. Deeply parses native Word structure, validates canonical BADGERS content-tree XML per page, and separately evaluates native fidelity and visual-semantic risk before returning a page route. native_docx pages are complete without an image; text-only multi-column pages and alignment uncertainty alone remain native. textract_ocr pages must first use Textract OCR and only go to Vision if its quality gate says so; hybrid and vision_ai pages use visual specialists.

document_path.description: S3 path or absolute local path to a .docx document.

max_image_size_mb.description: Maximum rendered Vision page image size in MiB. Default 4.0.

specialist.name: docx_processor
specialist.description: Safely parses DOCX OOXML, maps native structure to BADGERS content-tree XML, renders for page boundaries, and routes pages to native extraction, Textract OCR, or Vision AI.
